description: This file is a Java class that implements validation logic for ProviderAttributeType objects within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It extends a base validator and checks fields such as name and datatypeClassname for correctness, uniqueness, and proper format, including interactions with the ProviderService to prevent duplicate non-retired attribute types.
